description: Ask TikTok whether ad material would pass its ad review BEFORE you build the ad, so a rejection costs nothing. Submit up to 5 materials (videoIds and imageIds from upload_tiktok_ads_creative, adTexts, landingPageUrls) for ONE country the ad will run in. TikTok answers per material: APPROVED, REJECTED (with its reason and suggested fix), UNSURE or UNAVAILABLE. Submitting returns a taskId plus any verdicts already in, since short texts are often judged within seconds; a task usually finishes in about 5 minutes, so call again with taskId alone to read the rest. A material with no verdict yet is NOT approved. Results last 180 days and apply to the country reviewed only. Creates no ad and spends nothing.

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

isEcommerce.description: true when the material is for a catalog or TikTok Shop ad

landingPageUrls.description: full http(s) landing page URLs to check

location.description: ONE 2-letter country code the ad will run in, e.g. US; required to submit

taskId.description: read the verdicts of an earlier submission; omit to submit

name: prereview_tiktok_ads_creative
title: Pre-review TikTok ad material
